newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan Nov department store sales up 1.1 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Japan Nov department store sales up 1.1 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Sales at department stores in Japan rose 1.1 percent in November from a year earlier to 744.03 billion yen, up for the fourth consecutive month on a year-on-year basis, the Japan Department Stores' Association said on Tuesday.
"Department store sales remained on a gradual recovery trend as demand from individual customers stayed firm," the association said in a statement.
But sales of autumn and winter clothing were not very strong and demand from corporate customers remained sluggish in November, it said.
The survey covered 262 outlets of 108 companies.
